messages:
Alex_Sales: FYI - starting POC with Monarch Retail. They want streaming SDK + function/tool calls + strict JSON schema output. Also they sent the security questionnaire (SSQ). Need quick runbook + pricing estimate (hosted vs dedicated). Any blockers?
Maria_SE: Quick Qs: 1) expected QPS? 2) avg request length (tokens)? 3) need on-prem / VPC for data residency?
Alex_Sales: QPS ~50 steady, spikes to 200 for 10-15 mins. Avg user prompt ~120 tokens, response ~300 tokens. They prefer hosted but may require VPC for payment flows.
Sam_Engineer: For streaming with our SDK use the streaming client. Minimal python snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="...", stream=True)
for chunk in c.text.stream("gpt-4o-mini", prompt):
    handle(chunk)
```
Function/tool calling: include `function_call` in request; we return tool calls as structured JSON events. For strict structured output recommend attaching a JSON Schema and enabling strict mode (Content-Type: application/json enforced).
Jordan_SolutionEng: For SSQ: we can provide SOC2 report, security whitepaper, and architecture diagram. KMS: support for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). We can offer ephemeral creds for connector handshakes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/presales/poc-handoff
Alex_Sales: Monarch also asked about data retention & deletion policy. They want explicit deletion window and audit logs. Can someone own SSQ responses?
Maria_SE: Ballpark pricing: hosted unit gen cost ~ $0.0008/token (depends on model) + streaming overhead. For 50 qps avg with ~420 tokens/req that's material — I'll get exact monthly calc from finance. For Dedicated 6mo reserve: baseline is ~2x A100-80GB for their latency SLOs; sales ops will prepare a commit quote.
Sam_Engineer: Potential blocker: their adaptor is using legacy TLS ciphers. We need TLS1.2+ and SNI. They also want tool-calls over websocket; our proxy supports SSE + websocket handoff but we should document the handshake. Example handshake payload:
```json
{"handshake": "v1", "auth": "ephemeral-token"}
```
Alex_Sales: Can someone draft the SSQ answers and the short SDK runbook for their engs? Also need a clear run-of-show for the POC demo.
Jordan_SolutionEng: I'll take the SSQ and draft answers. Will ping legal on retention wording. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: Deploy notice: presales/monarch-poc-runbook v2 scheduled -> prod at 2024-07-18T21:00Z
Maria_SE: Also note for structured output: confirm support for nested arrays (they have receipts with line_items). Recommend schema with explicit maxItems for arrays to avoid surprises.
Alex_Sales: Thanks all. I'll schedule a 10am PT sync with Monarch sec + engs and share calendar invite.
